rule: PLAN CHANGE (HBM-FACE): input pin bits the core never reads (yosys proc/flatten/opt, bench-checked) are removed from the core pin table when the removal keeps pin names (top bits of a bus or the whole bus); interior unread bits stay pins (unread_kept, registered).  Partition side: the driving partition output for a dropped pin has no load (drop it from the partition table too).
